title: Arithmetic calculations measured by intracranial EEG in the human brain
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 20 epilepsy surgery candidates performing a sequential three-operand arithmetic task (easy and difficult equations in several numerical formats). The deposit contains preprocessed, bipolar-referenced epochs (512 Hz, -2 to +7 s around the first operand) with MNI electrode coordinates, and is released as a BIDS derivative of the authors' Zenodo data. It supports analysis of the temporal order of activations and interactions in brain networks during arithmetic calculation.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded with DIXI Medical electrodes and Natus Quantum amplifiers at 2048 Hz during pre-surgical evaluation. Stimuli were presented with PsychToolBox and synchronized by parallel-port triggers. Preprocessing by the source authors: low-pass filtering at 400 Hz and downsampling to 512 Hz, rejection of channels in seizure onset or irritative zones and of broken channels, bipolar referencing, 0.1 Hz high-pass filtering, 50 Hz notch filtering with harmonics, and epoching.
